title: Lin Jingyu's sword; Dao Xuan breaks the Tianji Seal
summary: Lin Jingyu fights Gui Li, asking why the man he trained day and night to stop had to be his old friend. Between blows he remembers their childhood sparring, when Xiaofan was slow but swore that hard work would carry him. Jingyu uses Wan Jianyi's Qingyun sword technique, Demon and God Slayer, and only breaks through when he remembers Wan Jianyi's lesson that the Dragon Slayer sword must go forward without hesitation. Gui Li asks how Jingyu would feel if the person killed were someone he loved, and Jingyu, shouting for Gui Li to give back his master and his brother Xiaofan, wins; Gui Li tells him to strike, since there is no one left he cares about. On the front mountain the Zhu Xian Sword Formation is raised against the Beast Deity, but the sword cannot reach its full power and the Beast Deity overwhelms Dao Xuan and the leaders. Dao Xuan kneels before the tablet of Ancestor Tiancheng, Qingyun's 17th leader, and confesses that he is breaking a rule and will bear the cost alone. He breaks the Tianji Seal, and the seven peaks pour their power, and the sword's evil aura, into the formation.
